title: Cambodia & Vietnam Experience with Visit to Angkor Wat
highlights: Go on a captivating journey through Cambodia and Vietnam, exploring iconic sites like Angkor Wat, Halong Bay, and Cu Chi Tunnels.
Learn about Hanoi’s rich heritage as you explore attractions like the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and the ancient Temple of Literature.
Experience Ba Na Hills on a full-day tour, while visiting the amazing Golden Hand Bridge, Linh Ung Pagoda and the Debay Wine Cellar.
Explore the wonders of Angkor Wat in Siem Reap, uncovering the charm of the largest religious structure in the world.
overview: The Cambodia Vietnam tour package from India is designed to deliver a well-rounded tour experience of the twin countries of Vietnam and Cambodia. Planned in a comprehensive manner, the tour package promises to offer an authentic slice of the Vietnamese way of life that the travellers can enjoy in a restful and hassle free manner.

know_before_you_go: Images are for representation purposes only.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as proof of identity.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change during peak season and blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at the Hanoi Airport, you will be transferred to your hotel in Hanoi for check in. Spend the rest of the day exploring the place at your own pace. You can visit places such as Thap Rua Tower, Bat Trang Ceramic Village, Quan Su Temple and other such attractions. Later, head back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Half-Day Cruise at Halong Bay
days.desc: Today, get ready to go on a half-day cruise at Halong Bay. Get transferred to the Tuan Chau Harbour to board your cruise. During the tour, witness the Dinh Huong and Ga Choi Islands, which look like two chickens with heavy bodies and tiny legs in a facing position. Further, stop at the stunning Thien Cung and Dau Go Caves. Later, disembark from the cruise and get transferred from the harbour to the hotel. The rest of the day is yours to explore markets and shopping centres around the city.

days.title: Hanoi City Tour | Transfer to Da Nang
days.desc: Today, check out of the hotel and board your transfer for the Hanoi city tour. Explore attractions such as Ngoc Son Temple, Hoan Kiem Lake, Temple of Literature and the One Pillar Pagoda. Further, visit the iconic Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum complex, the resting place of the revolutionary leader and former President, Ho Chi Minh. Afterwards, get transferred to the Hanoi Airport for your flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival at the Da Nang International Airport, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Ba Na Hills Full Day Tour | Transfer to Siem Reap
days.desc: Today,  get ready for an exciting day at the Ba Na Hills. Check out of the hotel and get transferred to Suoi Mo Station to take a cable car ride up to Marseille Station. Visit the Golden Hand Bridge, Linh Ung Pagoda and Debay Wine Cellar. Later, have leisure time at Fantasy Park, a family-friendly attraction. Then, return to the cable car station and get driven to the Da Nang International Airport for your flight to Siem Reap. Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to the hotel to check in.

days.title: Full Day Tour of Siem Reap
days.desc: In the morning, get ready to go on the Siem Reap full day tour, witnessing the awe-inspiring magnificence of Angkor Wat and its iconic surroundings. Begin with The South Gate of Angkor Thom, further exploring the charm of Bayon Temple, Chau say Tevoda, Ta Prohm Temple, and Ta Keo, among others. After a fun-filled day, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh
days.desc: On this day, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Siem Reap Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. As you reach Tan Son Nhat International Airport, you will be driven to the hotel for check in. Spend the rest of the day exploring the attractions of the city at your own leisure. Visit places such as Suối Tiên Theme Park, Reunification Palace, and Jade Emperor Pagoda. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Half Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour with Cu Chi Tunnel
days.desc: Start your day with a guided half-day tour of Ho Chi Minh City by boarding a pre-booked transfer from the hotel. Begin with a visit to the Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the Saigon Central Post Office, stunning examples of Gothic, Renaissance, and French influences. After exploring the city, head for the Cu Chi Tunnels, a vast network of underground tunnels used during the Vietnam War. Later, get transferred to the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City for an overnight stay.
